name: Vectara
tagline: Vectara is a managed retrieval-augmented generation platform that helps enterprises build AI applications that give accurate, grounded answers from their own documents and data. Engineering teams use it to add trusted question-answering and search to internal knowledge bases, customer support systems, and document-heavy workflows without building RAG infrastructure from scratch. Its built-in hallucination detection and grounded generation approach makes it suitable for regulated industries where AI responses need to cite their sources rather than produce confident-sounding text that may be inaccurate.
